title: Perfect matching in a bipartite graph
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix with entries in $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The bipartite graph specified by $A$ has a perfect matching if and only if it contains a subgraph that is a perfect matching.
